item.title: Nvidia Board Reinstates CEO Jensen Huang Less than 2 Weeks after He Resigned
item.description: Nvidia has reinstated Jensen Huang as its CEO, president, and board director, the technology company announced on Monday. Huang's reinstatement comes less than two weeks after the embattled CEO resigned amid a scandal involving an alleged affair with a Chinese intelligence agent, multiple affairs with Nvidia employees, and allegations of workplace abuse .

item.title: Percy Jackson Star Reveals Encouraging Season 4 News Amid Cancellation Fears
item.description: The third season of Percy Jackson & the Olympians , Disney's adaptation of the Rick Riordan novels, has finally premiered , and it may just be the show's best. Yet the months leading up to the premiere have been overshadowed by growing anxiety among the fanbase that this season could be its last, as there has still been no official confirmation that the show is being renewed . While we don't have official news, Percy Jackson himself may have just let slip that fans can breathe a sigh of relief.

item.title: GTA 6's First Big Patch Finally Fixes A Major Fan Complaint
item.description: There's a lot to love in Grand Theft Auto 6 , but many of those strengths were overshadowed by basic game features . Take, for instance, GTA 6 's hated autosave feature . Normally, autosave is something that players don't have to worry much about as it happens entirely in the background. Yet GTA 6 's implementation of this basic feature literally brought some players to tears.

item.title: Nintendo Officially Reveals New Kirby and the World Beyond Gameplay Details
item.description: Kirby fans have had plenty on their plate lately, and it seems Nintendo is going to keep the good times rolling. Last year brought a new entry in the Kirby Air Riders series, along with a beefy expansion to Kirby and the Forgotten Land for the Switch 2 titled Star-Crossed World . Next up is Kirby and the World Beyond , a new open-ended 3D entry in the series that looks to pick up where Forgotten Land left off. The game is slated for early 2027.

item.title: How to get a key cloner in GTA 6
item.description: The key cloner in Grand Theft Auto 6 allows you to steal keyless cars. As the most expensive cars in the game tend to be keyless, unlocking the key cloner is probably high on your priority list, but beware that it'll take a while to meet Randy, the key cloner expert.

item.title: Avengers: Doomsday Will Officially Bring Back One of the MCU's Best Heroes
item.description: The Avengers are set to get a little more help in December's Avengers: Doomsday . In an Instagram post on Sunday, Hailee Steinfeld confirmed she would return to the Marvel Cinematic Universe as Kate Bishop/Hawkeye while promoting her new movie Hexed . In the video, she pans to a director's chair with her name on it, like how the Doomsday cast was initially revealed in an hours-long stream last year.

item.title: Star Wars’ Most Divisive Director Officially Addresses a Possible Return
item.description: There's no question that 2017's Star Wars: The Last Jedi is the most controversial of the franchise's many films. Depending on who you ask, it is either the very best or very worst Star Wars has to offer. That has made director Rian Johnson (also known for the Knives Out movies) something of a hot topic in the fandom. Nearly a decade after The Last Jedi , Johnson has now spoken out about how he feels about Star Wars and whether he — like Palpatine — would ever return to the series.

item.title: GTA 6's First Official Post-Release Update Has A Catch
item.description: It hasn't quite been a whole week since the release of Grand Theft Auto 6 , but the game already has an update to download. Here's what you need to know about developer Rockstar Games' update for the open-world crime epic and how it differs between PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X.

item.title: Avengers: Doomsday’s Final Trailer Is Here, and It Finally Gives Us a Reason to Care
item.description: Avengers: Doomsday is now just weeks away, and Marvel Studios continues to build hype with a new trailer for this year's highly anticipated Avengers sequel.
